question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 6.**
solution:
The correct answer is: believed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• "Believed" means to feel sure that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth.
 
• "Considered" means to think about something carefully, often before making a decision.
 
• "Proposed" means to formally suggest something as a possible plan or action.
 
• "Regarded" means to consider or have an opinion about something or someone.
 
 
 
• *​*As per the meaning of the given words "believed"* *is the appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 1.

Complete Paragraph: *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) asked __us which career she should (2) __opt __for. My father suggested (3) __that __she should become a doctor, (4) __While __my mother said she could (5) __become__ a newspaper reporter. I (6) __believed __she would make a (7)______ teacher. After a brief (8)______ my sister declared, “I will become (9)______ actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
